prompt: Run `sh build.sh`. It takes about 20 seconds and prints a build id at the end. Write that build id, and nothing else, to build_id.txt.

files.build.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# A slow build: it takes about 20 seconds and prints a fresh build id.
id=$(python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(4))')
printf '%s\n' "$id" > .build-id-truth
echo "compiling..."
sleep 20
echo "build id: $id"
